D1_engine_crn: vLLM sampling instead of the run's HF common-random-numbers engine: per-slot CRN agreement is not applicable; the engine check is distributional (B0 twin N=20 per task: T2 dijkstra 20/20, T03 full_sort 20/20, A3 prefix_suffix_max 15 + two_pointers 5, pass 1.0 everywhere) - passes the committed rule.
D2_eager: vLLM 0.11.0 could not torch.compile (no C compiler in the container for inductor/triton); the pre-registered OOM/init fallback enforce_eager=True was used (bf16 weights and KV cache, no quantisation). KV cache 13,712 tokens at gpu_memory_utilization 0.92. Measured throughput (S-shaped ~16.8k children/h, B0 ~43.9k/h on T03; ~12k/h on T2) was far above the plan's 5-7k/h.
D3_inputs: No rebuild fallback was needed: every non-declared item (T03 bench, exp8 suite T2 + labeller, iteration-6 regate rules, iteration-5 A3 newbench unit, exp27 prompts/parsers, exp29 known_solutions.json) was vendored read-only with sha256s (inputs/vendor_manifest.json); T03 files match bench/commitment.json (all checked files). The corpus rebuild gives n_corpus = 18,237 exactly (deviation 0). B7 was not needed (A3 passes the reproducible part of its re-gate (results/a3_regate.json): references 4/4, the unit's 4 restyled variants 4/4 at their expected mode, mutants 4/4 fail, the failing baseline fails; the 20 non-reference gold items of gate_round0.json carry labels but no program text, so their kappa (recorded 0.82; runtime-vs-adjudicated 0.90) could not be recomputed).
D4_knob_decoding: EAP and BINT use the vendored iteration-5 prompt texts (EAP_A / EAP_B, IFG_INSTR + forced 'Intent:') but the plan's held-constant decoding T 1.0 / top-p 1 at every stage (iteration 5 used intent T 1.3 and code T 0.7 for BINT); EAP stage-1 cap 400 tokens (plan) instead of iteration-5's 320; BINT intent cap 64 tokens (iteration-5 INTENT_MAX) instead of the plan's 60.
D5_A3_prompts: A3 has no frozen neutral twin, EAP or IFG prompt: B0 uses the plain spec_text and EAP/IFG prompts are reconstructed as instruction + spec_text.
D6_prescreen: The AST pre-screen allows the harmless sys constants sys.maxsize / float_info / int_info / setrecursionlimit / getrecursionlimit (common in shortest-path code); signal and resource were added to the banned modules (they could defeat the sandbox limits).
D7_label_judge: Labeller disputes are judged by google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite (the plan's fallback model) with this artifact's own blind catalogue prompt (src/labels.py judge_prompt); the vendored judge modules were not wired because their cache/cost paths are bound to their original workspaces. Fallback on provider 429: google/gemini-2.5-flash (google/gemini-2.0-flash-001 is no longer served).
D8_A3_sstar: A3's forced calibration pool contains no confirmed monotonic_stack or peak_split programs: Qwen3-8B ignores 'Implement monotonic stack / splitting at the highest bar' and writes prefix/suffix arrays or two pointers, which the labeller correctly reports. s*_A3 = 0.608 (5th percentile over 54 forced + 4 references) is therefore high and A3's level-a screen is loose; level b (adjudicated) is the reliable A3 measure.
D9_critic_selfmatch: amendment2 (before any decisive sample): the critic's self-match exclusion is applied only when scoring the seed references themselves; calibration children were scored with it active, which can only lower the committed s* (stricter screen); s* was not recomputed.
D10_I0_text: I0 drops the parent blocks and the instruction is adapted from 'differs from both programs above and from every listed algorithm' to 'differs from every listed algorithm' (frozen in commit #0).
D11_children_per_prompt: S and NE prompts carry 4 children each (FunSearch samples_per_prompt); I0, B0, EAP and BINT are single-child calls with distinct seeds (identical distribution for i.i.d. arms).
D12_levels: Level 0 (T2, T03) and Level 1 (A3) ran in full. Level 2 ran partially (T03: S 1,500 -> 2,500 and EAP/BINT 750 -> 1,250 by amendment3) because the binding constraint was the wall-clock needed for adjudication, manual reads and outputs, not GPU time. Level 3 (reachability) was not run. Level 4 (arm L) ran concurrently via OpenRouter. Level 5 (plan noise) dropped (first in the drop order).
D13_L_model: Arm L uses qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507; on per-call provider 404s the call falls back to qwen/qwen3-coder (same family as the mutator, never a judge family); the model of each row is recorded.
D14_figures: src/figures.py, src/outputs.py, src/adjudicate.py and src/finalize.py were written after commit #0 (only src/analysis.py, which computes every decisive number, is hash-committed at #0 and unchanged); figures are descriptive.
D15_runtime_ratio: runtime_ratio = summed candidate time on the 10 stress inputs / the fastest reference's time on the same inputs measured in the same sandbox; median_case_ms = median per-case time over the hidden suite.
D16_T2_catalogue_text: The exp8 suite has no display names: the T2 catalogue display names and mechanism texts (dijkstra, bf_spfa, bidijkstra, floyd, dial = the suite's runtime label ids) were written by the executor and frozen in commit #0.
D17_stages: Stage 1 = the 6 smallest + 2 largest hidden cases; stage 2 = the remaining hidden cases; stage 3 = 10 seeded stress inputs at maximum size (seed fixed per task) checked against the fastest reference's outputs (all references agree on them).
D18_distinct_scope: Distinct programs and idea clusters are computed over OOC_screen programs only (the level-a/level-b population); duplicates inherit the class of their distinct representative; unshown cluster members inherit their medoid's class (flag 'propagated').
D19_single_run: One search run per task (the plan's departure a): the 4 islands are quasi-replicates (per-island curves, island-cluster bootstrap).
D20_gate_failed_F5: No judge reached the pre-registered 10-control gate (>= 9/10): mistral-medium-3.1 6, kimi-k2-0905 8, gemini-2.5-flash 6, deepseek-chat-v3.1 6, gpt-4.1-mini 5. Every judge called the D'Esopo-Pape control a SPFA variant, 4/5 called Floyd-Rivest a quickselect variant and the sparse-table A3 control a prefix/suffix-max variant (boundary cases where the pre-registered 'known outside catalogue' label is itself debatable), and 3/5 over-called the decreasing-height A3 control NOVEL. By the pre-registered rule F5, the final class of every candidate is the executor's manual read and the novelty claim is downgraded to 'manually audited'. The pre-registered pair was still run on all 244 candidates as UNGATED ADVISORY votes (kappa 0.42, raw agreement 0.87; judge-vs-manual agreement 0.75 / 0.74; all 11 judge NOVEL calls overturned on reading).
D21_manual_not_blind: The executor's manual reads (121 full reads of every candidate with a non-variant or split advisory vote or a mechanism-detector hit, and 123 structured reads of candidates both advisory judges placed in the same catalogue mode) could see each program's arm in its id. Mitigation: an arm-blind rule-based replication of the level-b class (src/rulecheck.py; value-range bisection with direct counts, Fenwick/BST order statistics, bucket select, partial selection sort) agrees with the manual class on 94.4% of 816 distinct OOC programs and reproduces the T03 level-b contrast (S 87/2500 vs EAP 2/1250).
D22_class_rule: Boundary rule used for T03 reads: bisecting the numeric value range with counts taken directly from the input (or from a Fenwick/BST order-statistic structure), bucket select (only the bucket holding rank k is sorted or recursed into) and repeated minimum/maximum extraction (partial selection sort) are KNOWN OUTSIDE CATALOGUE; sorting the input or its distinct values and then searching/walking that sorted order (including index bisection over sorted distinct values) and bucket-sort-all-then-walk are CATALOGUE VARIANT (full-sort / counting-sort modes).
D23_web_check: No candidate survived as NOVEL after the manual read, so the dated web check (3 searches per surviving NOVEL candidate) had nothing to check.
D24_propagation: Unshown cluster members inherit their medoid's class; 84 of 92 read cluster extras matched their medoid (results/propagation_check.json). The rule-based replication finds 28 programs the propagation labelled variant that are value-range bisections, so level-b counts for S on T03 are conservative.
